description: This is a unit test class for the OpenmrsUtil utility class in the OpenMRS project. It contains tests for various utility methods such as collection containment, password validation, date formatting, stack trace shortening, logging level application, and concept handling.

classes.name: OpenmrsUtilTest
classes.description: Test class for various static utility methods in OpenmrsUtil, including collection operations, password validation, date formats, stack trace processing, logging configurations, and concept handling.
